sources.quote: The Whirlpool Galaxy, also known as Messier 51a (M51a) or NGC 5194, is an interacting grand-design spiral galaxy with a Seyfert 2 active galactic nucleus.

introduction.text: Its picture is the Sloan Digital Sky Survey's, with the Milky Way's foreground stars removed, laid flat on its measured disc.

sources.quote: It lies in the constellation Canes Venatici, and was the first galaxy to be classified as a spiral galaxy.
